entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your refusal to bail out strugglin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your refusal to bail out struggling businesses in this climate is a hardline stance, President Rayne. Some might say too hardline."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It seems you've been quite generou..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems you've been quite generous in bailing out businesses, Anton. Not everyone would agree with that strategy in a recession."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You've chosen to forego constituti..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've chosen to forego constitutional reform, President Rayne. A decision that speaks volumes about your respect for tradition."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I've heard about your attempts at..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard about your attempts at constitutional reform, Anton. Not an easy path, if I recall correctly."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your decision not to align Sordlan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision not to align Sordland with the West is a perplexing one, President Rayne. It leaves one questioning your vision for our nation's place in the world."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""And your foreign policy, Anton. Qu..."
entries.dialogueText: "And your foreign policy, Anton. Quite the tightrope walk, isn't it? West, East, or the middle ground?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your decision not to construct a l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision not to construct a large-scale railway project between our major cities is a stance that confounds me. Such an initiative could have had transformative implications for corporate logistics."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your decision to maintain a strict..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision to maintain a stricter immigration policy is a departure from the open and inclusive vision I had for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your choice not to pursue constitu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your choice not to pursue constitutional reform is a conservative stance, differing from my belief that change is necessary for Sordland's advancement."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your choice not to pursue constitu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your choice not to pursue constitutional reform is a conservative stance, differing from my belief that change is necessary for Sordland's advancement."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your choice not to pursue constitu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your choice not to pursue constitutional reform is a conservative stance, differing from my belief that change is necessary for Sordland's advancement."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your decision to construct a railw..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision to construct a railway between our major cities is visionary, President Rayne. It will undoubtedly have significant positive implications for corporate logistics."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I see you've decided to further re..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see you've decided to further relax immigration policies, President Rayne. A choice I find commendable and aligned with the vision I had for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You've decided to reform the const..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've decided to reform the constitution, a brave move. It aligns with my belief that Sordland needs change."
